objective:
MILES EXECUTIVE DIRECTIVE

BUILD 044

Code Writer Capability Audit

Use the active production runtime.

Do not modify any files.

Do not generate proposals.

Determine whether MILES currently contains any component capable of generating complete replacement source files.

Search the entire MILES OS repository.

Look for classes, services, or modules that perform any of the following:

• writeFile
• fs.writeFile
• fs.writeFileSync
• createWriteStream
• patch generation
• replacement generation
• code generation
• source generation
• template generation

Also search for services named similarly to:

CodeWriter
ReplacementWriter
ReplacementGenerator
PatchEngine
PatchGenerator
CodeGenerator
EngineeringWriter
RuntimeWriter
TemplateEngine

For every match report:

- file
- function
- purpose
- whether it is currently invoked by EngineeringImprovementService

Finally answer:

1. Does a production code-generation engine exist?

2. If yes, why is EngineeringImprovementService not calling it?

3. If no, explicitly state:

"The current MILES runtime has no code-generation engine. EngineeringImprovementService can only generate engineering proposals."

Do not recommend changes.

Return evidence only.
executiveSummary: Engineering proposal package created. No production files were modified.
